
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/yeyunfei/p/19933345" title="发布于 2026-04-26 18:38">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">AI+Web3D:我让AI写了一年Three.js，结果它连一个内网白屏都修不了</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        Web3D工业落地，AI写Three.js代码上线报废？内网白屏、Chromium49崩溃、国产浏览器CONTEXT_LOST_WEBGL修复方案。真实踩坑实录：离线部署、老浏览器兼容、GPU上下文恢复。AI时代程序员不可替代的技术壁垒。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span style="font-size: 18px"><strong>很久没写了，<br>我必须先说一句：AI写3D代码，确实强。</strong></span></p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span style="font-size: 18pt"><strong>强到让人心慌。</strong></span></p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">以前我要翻三天文档、试七八种方案才能搭出来的模型交互管线，它十几秒全吐出来。GLTF加载、PBR材质、后处理特效，甚至我还没来得及想到的细节优化，它都能自动补全。</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">比如这段，我让AI写一个简单得模型加载代码，说实话，我自己手写也就这个水平：</p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<pre><span class="token comment">// AI生成的Three.js模型加载——标准环境完美运行
<span class="token keyword">import <span class="token punctuation">{ GLTFLoader <span class="token punctuation">} <span class="token keyword">from <span class="token string">'three/examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.js'<span class="token punctuation">;

<span class="token keyword">const loader <span class="token operator">= <span class="token keyword">new <span class="token class-name">GLTFLoader<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
loader<span class="token punctuation">.<span class="token function">load<span class="token punctuation">(
  <span class="token string">'/assets/model.glb'<span class="token punctuation">,
  <span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token parameter">gltf<span class="token punctuation">) <span class="token operator">=&gt; <span class="token punctuation">{
    scene<span class="token punctuation">.<span class="token function">add<span class="token punctuation">(gltf<span class="token punctuation">.scene<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
    console<span class="token punctuation">.<span class="token function">log<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token string">'模型加载成功'<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
  <span class="token punctuation">}<span class="token punctuation">,
  <span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token parameter">progress<span class="token punctuation">) <span class="token operator">=&gt; <span class="token punctuation">{
    console<span class="token punctuation">.<span class="token function">log<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token template-string"><span class="token template-punctuation string">`<span class="token string">加载进度: <span class="token interpolation"><span class="token interpolation-punctuation punctuation">${<span class="token punctuation">(progress<span class="token punctuation">.loaded <span class="token operator">/ progress<span class="token punctuation">.total <span class="token operator">* <span class="token number">100<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">.<span class="token function">toFixed<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token number">2<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token interpolation-punctuation punctuation">}<span class="token string">%<span class="token template-punctuation string">`<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
  <span class="token punctuation">}<span class="token punctuation">,
  <span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token parameter">error<span class="token punctuation">) <span class="token operator">=&gt; <span class="token punctuation">{
    console<span class="token punctuation">.<span class="token function">error<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token string">'模型加载失败:'<span class="token punctuation">, error<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
  <span class="token punctuation">}
<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">看起来没毛病对吧？加载进度回调、错误处理，该有的都有。</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">那一刻，说实话，我后背是凉的。六年的经验，在它面前好像瞬间贬值了。</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">但我这个人有个毛病：慌完，就会开始找它的破绽。</p>
<hr>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/800616/202604/800616-20260426182953473-1664736583.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<hr>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">于是过去半年，我干了一件事：专门把AI写的Three.js代码，往"地狱环境"里扔。</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">什么是地狱环境？不是你那台MacBook，也不是Chrome最新版。是客户现场的工控机——Win7嵌入式、Chromium 49内核、核显、断网、安全软件还在后台悄悄删着东西。</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">AI的代码，在这里，死得很惨。</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">第一个翻车现场：内网离线环境，贴图全白</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">AI生成的加载器用的路径是&nbsp;<code>/assets/model.glb</code>，里面内嵌的纹理引用了一堆相对路径。本地没问题，一丢到客户那台断网、没有外网DNS的内网服务器上——</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">全白。</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">控制台不报错，<code>GLTFLoader</code>&nbsp;静默失败，连error回调都没触发。AI根本不知道，有些内网环境里，浏览器连&nbsp;<code>blob:</code>&nbsp;协议都会被安全策略拦截。</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">我最后改成了这样：</p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<pre><span class="token comment">// 修复方案：内网离线环境适配
<span class="token keyword">import <span class="token punctuation">{ GLTFLoader <span class="token punctuation">} <span class="token keyword">from <span class="token string">'three/examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.js'<span class="token punctuation">;

<span class="token keyword">const loader <span class="token operator">= <span class="token keyword">new <span class="token class-name">GLTFLoader<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
<span class="token comment">// 关键：设置跨域策略，接管纹理加载
loader<span class="token punctuation">.<span class="token function">setCrossOrigin<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token string">'anonymous'<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
<span class="token comment">// 关键：禁用外部资源请求，强制所有纹理base64内嵌
loader<span class="token punctuation">.<span class="token function">setResourcePath<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token string">''<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;

<span class="token comment">// 预检测：当前环境是否支持blob协议
<span class="token keyword">const isBlobSupported <span class="token operator">= <span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">) <span class="token operator">=&gt; <span class="token punctuation">{
  <span class="token keyword">try <span class="token punctuation">{
    <span class="token keyword">const testBlob <span class="token operator">= <span class="token keyword">new <span class="token class-name">Blob<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">[<span class="token string">'test'<span class="token punctuation">]<span class="token punctuation">, <span class="token punctuation">{ <span class="token literal-property property">type<span class="token operator">: <span class="token string">'text/plain' <span class="token punctuation">}<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
    <span class="token constant">URL<span class="token punctuation">.<span class="token function">createObjectURL<span class="token punctuation">(testBlob<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
    <span class="token keyword">return <span class="token boolean">true<span class="token punctuation">;
  <span class="token punctuation">} <span class="token keyword">catch <span class="token punctuation">(e<span class="token punctuation">) <span class="token punctuation">{
    <span class="token keyword">return <span class="token boolean">false<span class="token punctuation">;
  <span class="token punctuation">}
<span class="token punctuation">}<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;

<span class="token keyword">if <span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token operator">!isBlobSupported<span class="token punctuation">) <span class="token punctuation">{
  console<span class="token punctuation">.<span class="token function">warn<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token string">'当前环境不支持Blob协议，纹理将降级为纯色材质'<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
  <span class="token comment">// 后续走降级渲染分支
<span class="token punctuation">}</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">AI不会写这段。它没见过一个连&nbsp;<code>Blob</code>&nbsp;都跑不了的环境。</p>
<hr>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span style="font-size: 18pt"><strong>第二个翻车现场</strong></span>：</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">老浏览器，跑着跑着GPU上下文直接丢了</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">AI写的渲染循环干净利落：</p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<pre><span class="token comment">// AI生成的标准渲染循环
<span class="token keyword">function <span class="token function">animate<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">) <span class="token punctuation">{
  <span class="token function">requestAnimationFrame<span class="token punctuation">(animate<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
  renderer<span class="token punctuation">.<span class="token function">render<span class="token punctuation">(scene<span class="token punctuation">, camera<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
  stats<span class="token punctuation">.<span class="token function">update<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
<span class="token punctuation">}
<span class="token function">animate<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">放在Chrome最新版，稳如老狗。</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">放到那台国产化双核浏览器的极速模式下，跑不到五秒，整个canvas黑掉。控制台抛出一个AI从来没处理过的东西：</p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<pre><strong>WebGL: CONTEXT_LOST_WEBGL</strong></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">然后页面卡死，什么动静都没了。用户刷新也没用，因为浏览器已经把GPU进程挂起了。</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">AI的代码里，没有对这一行的任何防御。</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">我加的修复：</p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<pre><span class="token comment">// 修复方案：老浏览器GPU上下文丢失防御
<span class="token keyword">function <span class="token function">animate<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">) <span class="token punctuation">{
  <span class="token function">requestAnimationFrame<span class="token punctuation">(animate<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
  
  <span class="token keyword">try <span class="token punctuation">{
    renderer<span class="token punctuation">.<span class="token function">render<span class="token punctuation">(scene<span class="token punctuation">, camera<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
  <span class="token punctuation">} <span class="token keyword">catch <span class="token punctuation">(e<span class="token punctuation">) <span class="token punctuation">{
    <span class="token comment">// 捕获渲染异常，避免整个循环崩溃
    console<span class="token punctuation">.<span class="token function">warn<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token string">'渲染帧失败，跳过当前帧:'<span class="token punctuation">, e<span class="token punctuation">.message<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
    <span class="token keyword">return<span class="token punctuation">;
  <span class="token punctuation">}
<span class="token punctuation">}

<span class="token comment">// 核心：接管上下文丢失事件
renderer<span class="token punctuation">.domElement<span class="token punctuation">.<span class="token function">addEventListener<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token string">'webglcontextlost'<span class="token punctuation">, <span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token parameter">event<span class="token punctuation">) <span class="token operator">=&gt; <span class="token punctuation">{
  <span class="token comment">// 阻止默认行为，争取恢复时间
  event<span class="token punctuation">.<span class="token function">preventDefault<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
  console<span class="token punctuation">.<span class="token function">warn<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token string">'WebGL上下文丢失，2秒后尝试恢复...'<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
  
  <span class="token comment">// 暂停渲染，释放部分GPU内存
  <span class="token function">cancelAnimationFrame<span class="token punctuation">(animationId<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
  
  <span class="token comment">// 尝试上下文恢复
  <span class="token function">setTimeout<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">) <span class="token operator">=&gt; <span class="token punctuation">{
    renderer<span class="token punctuation">.domElement<span class="token punctuation">.<span class="token function">addEventListener<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token string">'webglcontextrestored'<span class="token punctuation">, <span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">) <span class="token operator">=&gt; <span class="token punctuation">{
      console<span class="token punctuation">.<span class="token function">log<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token string">'上下文已恢复，重新启动渲染'<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
      <span class="token function">animate<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
    <span class="token punctuation">}<span class="token punctuation">, <span class="token punctuation">{ <span class="token literal-property property">once<span class="token operator">: <span class="token boolean">true <span class="token punctuation">}<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
  <span class="token punctuation">}<span class="token punctuation">, <span class="token number">2000<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
<span class="token punctuation">}<span class="token punctuation">, <span class="token boolean">false<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;

<span class="token comment">// 额外保险：检测浏览器是否为国产双核
<span class="token keyword">const isOldBrowser <span class="token operator">= <span class="token regex"><span class="token regex-delimiter">/<span class="token regex-source language-regex">360|LieBao|MetaSr<span class="token regex-delimiter">/<span class="token punctuation">.<span class="token function">test<span class="token punctuation">(navigator<span class="token punctuation">.userAgent<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
<span class="token keyword">if <span class="token punctuation">(isOldBrowser<span class="token punctuation">) <span class="token punctuation">{
  <span class="token comment">// 降低像素比，减少GPU内存压力
  renderer<span class="token punctuation">.<span class="token function">setPixelRatio<span class="token punctuation">(Math<span class="token punctuation">.<span class="token function">min<span class="token punctuation">(window<span class="token punctuation">.devicePixelRatio<span class="token punctuation">, <span class="token number">1<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
  <span class="token comment">// 关闭阴影、后处理等耗GPU特性
  renderer<span class="token punctuation">.shadowMap<span class="token punctuation">.enabled <span class="token operator">= <span class="token boolean">false<span class="token punctuation">;
<span class="token punctuation">}</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">这段代码放进去之后，那台老机器跑了一个下午，没再崩过。</p>
<h3><span style="font-size: 14px">我盯着那些崩溃的日志，突然笑了。</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">不是嘲笑AI，是松了一口气。</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">原来，它强是真的，但它"没见过真实世界"也是真的。它的训练数据里，全是理想环境。标准浏览器、最新API、完善网络、最新驱动——这些在真实工业现场，是幻觉。</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">它不是神，它只是一个在完美环境里长大的学霸，从来没踩过泥坑。</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">而中国有多少这样的泥坑？国产化双核浏览器、内网安全策略拦截、老旧的硬件必须继续跑、杀毒软件把WebGL当病毒……这些，AI一行代码都解决不了。</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">不是说它以后解决不了，而是现在，它真的干不了。</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">想通这一点之后，我的焦虑就过去了。<br>不是因为我比AI聪明，而是因为我想明白了接下来我要干什么：</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">AI负责在完美的环境里，生成漂亮的Demo。<br>我负责在真实的地狱里，让它跑起来。</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">它给我降本增效，我给它擦屁股。<br>它当大脑，我当那个知道怎么在泥巴里走路的人。</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">技术壁垒，的确被冲垮了一道。<br>但新的壁垒，就在AI写的那堆代码"跑死在客户现场"的瞬间，重新立了起来。</p>
<hr>
<p><img alt="b421314adc0c4330d4ecf841e34569de" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/800616/202604/800616-20260426183447631-614478577.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<hr>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">所以现在，我拥抱AI，每天都在用。<br>但也每天都在它的输出里，找到了自己非存在不可的理由。</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">这件事，焦虑过，现在清醒了。</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">如果你也觉得技术被替代了，别盯着它擅长的看。<br>去把它写的代码，扔到你最烂的一台设备上，跑一下。</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">答案就在那个报错里。</p>

</div>
